description: Defines the SysVMessageQueue class for inter-process message queuing using System V message queues, including creation, sending, and receiving messages.

classes.name: SysVMessageQueue
classes.description: A class encapsulating System V message queue operations such as creation, sending, and receiving messages.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new SysVMessageQueue instance with a specified queue name and auto-close behavior.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Method to send data through the message queue, with blocking behavior controlled by the 'block' parameter.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Method to receive data from the message queue, specifying message type and blocking behavior.
